  struct Payload
    field number: Int
    field text: String
  enum Event
    Ready(Payload)
    Empty
  fun check<T>(value: T, test: (T) -> Boolean): Boolean
    =
      Call test
        Var value
  fun describe(event: Event): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var event
        arm Ready(Payload{number: -1, text}) if <guard>
          IntLiteral 11
        arm Ready(Payload{number: 0, text: "zero"})
          IntLiteral 12
        arm Ready(_)
          IntLiteral 13
        arm Empty
          IntLiteral 14
  fun main()
    Call println

        MethodCall Ready

            Unary Neg

        FieldAccess Empty
          Var Event
    val pair
      TupleLiteral
        BoolLiteral false
        UnitLiteral

        Var pair
